classification.reason: Request is a scientific goal or asks for planning without a concrete workflow.

plan.goal: Retrieve representative sequences for NAD(P)HX repair proteins carrying ADP-dependent NAD(P)H-hydrate dehydratase (GO:0070207) and NADPHX epimerase (GO:0070208) activity from both GO-based and InterPro domain-based sources, cross-validate candidates with GPU-accelerated similarity search, characterise each activity class with sequence-level analysis, and rank the combined representative set.
assumptions: GO:0070207 (ADP-dependent NAD(P)H-hydrate dehydratase activity) and GO:0070208 (NADPHX epimerase activity) are the canonical UniProt molecular-function terms for the two catalytic activities of the NAD(P)HX repair system.
IPR023030 covers the NADHX dehydratase-like superfamily and provides complementary domain-based sequence coverage to the GO-term retrieval.
IEA evidence codes are excluded from GO-based retrieval to restrict candidates to experimentally or computationally curated annotations.
Reviewed-only (SwissProt) entries are used for all three retrieval nodes to maximise annotation reliability; coverage is expected to be sufficient for this well-characterised repair system.
mmseqs2_gpu cross-searches (dehydratase-vs-InterPro and epimerase-vs-InterPro) identify sequences supported by both activity annotation and domain membership, strengthening representativeness.
sequence_analysis is applied independently to each GO-based set to capture class-specific amino-acid composition, charge profile, and functional motifs before aggregation.
No 3-D structure inputs are available; ranking relies entirely on sequence-level metrics from sequence_analysis and similarity-search hit scores.
A sequence-identity floor of 0.3 with coverage 0.8 for mmseqs2_gpu is appropriate to detect distant homologs across the divergent NAD(P)HX repair superfamily.
top_k=20 in rank_designs is set to surface adequate diversity across both enzymatic-activity classes while keeping the candidate list tractable.

success_criteria.sequences_retrieved: Non-empty FASTA returned from go_sequences(GO:0070207), go_sequences(GO:0070208), and interpro_sequences(IPR023030)
success_criteria.cross_search_completed: mmseqs2_gpu produces similarity-hit tables for both dehydratase-vs-InterPro and epimerase-vs-InterPro searches
success_criteria.analyses_produced: sequence_analysis generates composition, charge, region, and motif records for both GO-based sequence sets
success_criteria.ranked_output: rank_designs returns a scored list of up to 20 representative NAD(P)HX repair protein candidates with full analysis and QC provenance
